Anthony Trollope, He Knew He Was Right.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/anthony-trollope/he-knew-he-was-right

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Anthony Trollope, the author, died 1882 (citizenship: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland).

First publication of the text used: 1869 (SE colophon: 'He Knew He Was Right was published in 1869 by Anthony Trollope.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1869, before 1931. A published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so this work entered it in 1964.
- Country of origin (the country of first publication is not named in the facts): the work is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less. The last person to die did so in 1882.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
